fallback_history.trigger: new immutable history file creation blocked by connector safety/write guard
fallback_history.append_rule: Fetch ledger and blob SHA; preserve exact prior bytes; append exactly one compact JSON object plus newline with previous_ledger_blob_sha equal to fetched SHA and the complete finalized payload; update with fresh SHA; re-fetch; verify exact-prefix preservation; parse the appended suffix as exactly one JSONL record whose top-level RUN_ID equals the intended RUN_ID. Nested RUN_ID fields inside the complete payload are allowed and must match; never use raw substring-count uniqueness.
fallback_history.completed_run_rule: Verified ledger fallback containing the complete finalized payload is valid GitHub history identity; latest and manifest may advance only after structural ledger readback verification.
fallback_history.partial_run_rule: If complete finalized payload is unavailable, append only truthful PARTIAL_PERSISTENCE receipt and do not advance latest/manifest.
